mechanism: A large idiosyncratic positive half-day move in one major smart-contract chain native can capture investor attention and capital. If cross-chain reallocation is not instantaneous, the shocked chain may continue to outperform rival chain natives over the next half-day.

literature_anchor.title: One Rising Ship Sinks Other Ships: Cross-Chain Negative Spillovers in Crypto Markets
literature_anchor.documented_mechanism: Attention-induced capital reallocation among competing blockchain ecosystems.
literature_anchor.distinction: The paper uses chain portfolios and several activity proxies. This MVE is a separate executable translation using only native-token price attention shocks.

material_difference: Signal is not BTC-led and not unconditional lead-lag.
Signal is a cross-sectional extreme positive return among competing chain natives.
Trade is market-neutral-ish winner versus rival basket.
No funding/OI feature enters the signal.

chronology.rule: 2025 outcomes remain unopened unless every frozen Discovery gate passes.

signal.observed_return: 12h log return ending at decision boundary
signal.attention_threshold: current positive 12h return >= own past-only rolling 95th percentile
signal.multi_shock_resolution: highest current return / own past-only 180-halfday standard deviation
signal.entry: 1h OPEN one hour after decision boundary
signal.exit: 1h OPEN thirteen hours after decision boundary, giving a 12h holding interval
signal.overlap: A new signal may enter only when its entry timestamp is >= prior trade exit timestamp.
signal.position: long winner 1.0 notional; short equal-weight other three totaling 1.0 notional

pnl.price_component: winner log return - mean(rival log returns)
pnl.funding_component: For every funding settlement in (entry, exit], contribution = -position_weight * funding_rate; long winner weight +1, each short rival weight -1/3.

source_gate.full: All four trade symbols have >=46/48 monthly kline archives and >=46/48 funding archives, with >=11 of each in every calendar year.
source_gate.blocked: Any trade symbol below full; no outcome opens.

no_rescue: No dropping a chain after outcomes.
